claims.evidence: The witness reports the headlights are wrapped in plastic film, which prevents a clear assessment of the lens surface for scratches or oxidation.

risks.proof: Clear photos of the rear and sides of both headlight housings showing all mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: as having broken brackets requiring structural repair.

risks.risk: Internal electrical failure or dead LED modules.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the headlights connected to a 12V source and cycling through all light functions.
risks.if_unproven: as non-functional units for parts only.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (Toyota has hundreds of headlight variations).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the manufacturer part number sticker on the headlight housing.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest-value generic Toyota headlight assembly.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the part number stickers on the housing.
Photos of the rear of the units to inspect the mounting tabs.
Video of the lights powered on to verify functionality.
Photos of the lenses with the plastic film removed.
response.reason: The specific vehicle model and year are unknown, and the plastic wrap obscures the actual condition of the lenses. A baseline price cannot be established without knowing which Toyota vehicle these fit.
